connection: A fresh sqlite3 connection is opened per request via get_connection() in db.py; raw SQL, no ORM.
queries: Single-row lookups by prescription id, update of refills_left, and insert into refill_log.
transactions: One implicit transaction per request, committed explicitly after the update and log insert.
n_plus_one: None in the original single-refill flow.
concurrency: None; sqlite3 default isolation with no explicit locking.

optimization_targets.description: Add a batch_refill_endpoint that accepts a list of rx ids, validates each prescription, deducts refills, logs the refills, and reports per-item results so many refills can be processed in one request.

notes: The new endpoint must fully implement per-item validation, refill deduction, and error reporting; a failing item must not abort the rest of the batch.
